subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the production dashboard publish `/bay-demo` as an unauthenticated public-by-URL experiment with bounded live-only terminal and timing state?
rationale: Technical review and real browser proof do not decide whether this discoverable production surface, audience, and ongoing operational contract match maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor public experiment
options.body: Approve the unlisted/noindexed but public route and bounded live-only semantics as an explicitly experimental production surface.

options.title: Require gated access
options.body: Require Cloudflare Access or application authentication before deployment if the intended audience is maintainers only.

options.title: Pause deployment
options.body: Keep the prototype out of production if no dashboard owner accepts the ongoing surface and evaluation cost.

recommendation.title: Sponsor public experiment
recommendation.body: Approve the unlisted/noindexed but public route and bounded live-only semantics as an explicitly experimental production surface.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner of the dashboard Worker/status surface and was explicitly asked for the rollout decision.
